info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Webhook Endpoint Rotate Secret-spec
info.description: The Webhook Secret Rotation API enables the secure updating of secret keys associated with webhook endpoints. This functionality is critical for maintaining the integrity and confidentiality of automated interactions between services. Developers and system administrators can utilize this API to rotate secrets as a security measure, ensuring that outdated or compromised keys are replaced. This process is essential for applications relying on secure webhook mechanisms, enhancing the overall security posture of the integration with third-party services.

post.summary: Rotate the secret for a specific webhook endpoint.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to rotate the secret associated with the specified webhook endpoint, ensuring the security and integrity of communications. It provides a mechanism to update the authentication secret, helping to maintain secure connections.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to trigger a secret rotation for a specific webhook endpoint identified by RES-100045. It should contain all necessary data required for the operation to be executed successfully.

200.description: The secret has been successfully rotated.
